userParameters.name: BatteryLength
userParameters.comment: Battery length. Use a 0.5-7 tolerance dependant on materials used

userParameters.name: BatteryDiameter
userParameters.comment: Diameter of battery.  0.5-7 tolerance dependant on materials used

userParameters.name: MagnetDiameter
userParameters.comment: Diameter of magnet used. a .20 tolerance in Petg allows a push fit

userParameters.name: MagnetDepth
userParameters.comment: Recessed depth for magnets to sit. I've found no tolerance is needed here

userParameters.name: CaseWidth
userParameters.expression: ( ( BatteryDiameter * BatteryRow ) + ( BatteryRow * InternalCellSpacing - InternalCellSpacing ) ) + ( WallThickness * 2 ) + ( MagnetDiameter * 2 )
userParameters.comment: Case width. Fixed Formula, do not modify

userParameters.name: CaseHeight
userParameters.comment: Case height formula. Fixed formula, do not modify.

userParameters.name: CaseLidHeight
userParameters.comment: Determines how tall the body of the battery lid is sans the lip that envelopes the body. Fixed formula, do not modify

userParameters.name: MagnetPadOffset
userParameters.comment: Offset used to determine the magnet's placesment relative to the outer wall running along the x axisl Fixed formula, do not modify

userParameters.name: CaseDepth
userParameters.expression: ( MagnetPadOffset * 2 ) + ( ( BatteryCol - 1 ) * InternalCellSpacing ) + ( BatteryCol * BatteryDiameter ) + ( WallThickness * 2 )
userParameters.comment: Determines depth of case. Fixed formula, do not modify

userParameters.name: BatteryCol
userParameters.comment: Number of batteries relative to the y axis.

userParameters.name: InternalCellSpacing
userParameters.comment: Determines the amount of spacing between the cell dividers in mm

userParameters.name: WallThickness
userParameters.comment: Determines outer wall and bottom layer thickness.

userParameters.name: BatteryRow
userParameters.comment: Number of batteries relative to the x axis.

userParameters.name: magnetCount
userParameters.comment: Determines number of magnets to use. Is a fixed formula, but is currently non functional due to an error with the cutout rectangular pattern. WIP

userParameters.name: BatteryToHolder
userParameters.comment: how deep battery sits in the main body

userParameters.name: lidtobattery
userParameters.comment: how deep battery sits in the lid

userParameters.name: EdgeRounding
userParameters.comment: Determines the edge chamfer. Fixed formula; can be modified but is currently constrained to the battery size to keep shape relative.

userParameters.name: lidOffset
userParameters.comment: Determines the body upper inset and lid lip offset. Fixed to wallthickness; can be modified.

userParameters.name: LidToleranceApplied
userParameters.comment: Lid Tolerance Formula. Do not Modify (see the lidtolerance variable to adjust this)

userParameters.name: LidTolerance
userParameters.comment: sets the inset tolerance of the body offsets for the lid on the case.
